s.en: List or process pending systemd password requests

o.en: Lists all currently pending system password requests. Added in version 186.
Process all currently pending system password requests by querying the user on the calling TTY. Added in version 186.
Continuously process password requests. Added in version 186.
Forward password requests to wall(1) instead of querying the user on the calling TTY. Added in version 186.
Ask question with plymouth(8) instead of querying the user on the calling TTY. Added in version 186.
Ask question on TTY DEVICE instead of querying the user on the calling TTY. If DEVICE is not specified, /dev/console will be used. Added in version 186.
Print a short help text and exit.
Print a short version string and exit.
